name: prompt-input
description: A textarea input for entering chat prompts with auto-resize, keyboard shortcuts, and send button
designIntent: The PromptInput component provides a specialized input for chat interfaces. It handles auto-resizing as the user types, supports Enter to submit (Shift+Enter for new line), and integrates with the conversation flow. It's designed to be the primary way users interact with AI assistants.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Callback when the user submits the prompt

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text to display when input is empty

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Whether a submission is currently in progress

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to auto-focus the input on mount

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum character count for the input

props.name: showSendButton
props.description: Whether to show the send button

props.name: sendButtonText
props.description: Text or icon for the send button

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the container

props.name: onStop
props.description: While loading, the send button becomes a stop button that calls this handler.

props.name: stopButtonText
props.description: Accessible label for the stop button; enables localization.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use for non-chat input
antiPatterns.description: PromptInput is specifically for chat interactions, not general form input

antiPatterns.title: Don't ignore Enter key behavior
antiPatterns.description: Users expect Enter to submit. If you change this, communicate it clearly

antiPatterns.title: Don't validate after submission
antiPatterns.description: Disable the input when empty rather than validating in the handler

accessibility.implementation: Full keyboard support with Enter to submit, Shift+Enter for new line
Textarea has proper label and placeholder. Button state is announced
accessibility.userRequirements: Ensure placeholder text is descriptive and helpful

accessibility.implementation: Button is disabled when input is empty, preventing invalid submissions
accessibility.userRequirements: Consider adding aria-invalid for custom validation if needed

accessibility.implementation: Textarea automatically grows with content up to max-height
accessibility.userRequirements: Test with screen readers to ensure height changes are announced appropriately

guidelines: Be specific about what kind of input is expected
Consider the context of the conversation
goodExamples: Describe what you'd like to build...

guidelines: Use clear icons or text for the send button
Consider using an arrow icon (→) for a modern look
Disable button when input is empty

compositionRules.relationship: PromptInput is typically used below a Conversation component to add new messages
compositionRules.example: Conversation displays messages, PromptInput submits new ones to the same messages array

compositionRules.relationship: PromptInput is often part of a ChatLayout that combines Conversation and input
compositionRules.example: ChatLayout wraps Conversation and PromptInput in a complete chat interface
